function.arguments: {"index": 5, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The treatment and control groups are confounded by baseline severity, as clinicians assigned treatment preferentially to sicker patients. A raw comparison of response rates would be biased. Therefore, we computed the treatment effect within each severity stratum (mild, moderate, severe) and then combined them using a weighted average, with weights based on the distribution of severity in the full sample. This adjusts for confounding and provides an unbiased estimate of the treatment effect on response rate."}
function.name: resolve_finding
